common_measurement_dependencies: Python standard library and Windows PSAPI
dependency_scope_note: NumPy-only describes inference independence from Torch/sklearn; the instrumented sampling process also imports the common measurement dependencies.
input_scope: All 256 historical A6-A8 replay observations, original 24 log spectral features
latency_scope: One public predictor API call from prepared log features to allocated float64 x/y output, including original casts/scaling and predictor checks; excludes file loading, input-row selection, validation against the reference, and memory sampling.
batch1_timed_row_indices: ((repeat-1)*100 + call_index) % 256, call_index=0..99; both backends and models use identical row order. All 256 rows are covered across five repetitions.
batch256_input: The complete 256-row matrix on every call
condition_order: Rotate [torch_l31/cnn, numpy_only/cnn, torch_l31/mlp8, numpy_only/mlp8] by repeat-1 positions
baseline_scope: Each implementation's actual imports, verified numeric inputs/reference, generic 8x8 float32 NumPy matrix warmup. Torch L31 also warms an 8x8 Torch matrix operation; NumPy does not import Torch. Baselines intentionally include different framework dependencies.
interpretation: Implementation effect including dependency removal, not pure model RAM. Torch L31 imports include NumPy, Torch and scikit-learn through the original project functions; do not call the full baseline PyTorch itself.
peak_scope: OS process-lifetime peaks include imports, loading and previous stages. Batch256 follows batch1; peaks are cumulative, never baseline-subtracted into model-only peak RAM.
signed_increments: RSS/private-commit differences from each process baseline are retained without clipping negative values.
numeric_gate: Every timed output coordinate is compared against original Torch using the identical batch shape. Report all conditions and slow/failed outcomes; do not select a faster batch or backend after measurement.
execution_gate: Explicit --confirm-training-finished required after root confirms concurrent training has ended.
